## LendLoop - Error handler
Set as `errorWorkflow` of the other LendLoop workflows. Builds a SAFE summary (no payload, emails/tokens redacted, 300 chars) and
1. emails the admin (`LENDLOOP_ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL`),
2. POSTs it to Convex `/api/n8n/automation-events` (shown in the admin dashboard).

**Needs env**: `LENDLOOP_ADMIN_ALERT_EMAIL`, `LENDLOOP_MAIL_FROM`, `LENDLOOP_CONVEX_SITE_URL`.
**Needs credentials**: SMTP `LendLoop SMTP`, Header Auth `LendLoop Convex inbound`.
